name: dialog
title: Dialog
description: Styled Solid dialog component backed by Keystone overlay behavior.

meta.customization: Style the generated wrappers through mason-dialog classes while Keystone keeps focus, dismissal, layering, and ARIA behavior.

parity.baseUi: Thin vertical covers Root/Trigger/Portal/Backdrop/Popup-style anatomy, controlled open state, modal dismissal, Escape handling, focus entry/restore, and stable data attributes through Keystone overlay internals. Gaps: outside hiding/inert depth, nested modal edge cases, transition status metadata, scroll lock polish, and preventable autofocus events remain follow-up work.
parity.kobalte: Matches Solid Dialog composition with trigger, portal, overlay/content, title, description, controlled state, and dismissable-layer direction. Gaps: create-focus-scope parity, hide-outside ref counting, create-transition lifecycle, and broader browser accessibility tests remain follow-up work.
